{
  "page_id": "prefecthq/prefect/README.md",
  "source_sha256": "ea65184760f7e6d32def7fc740e6b1bebe31edae113323a891d80243d704795e",
  "units": [
    {"ordinal":0,"function":"other","proposition":"","support":"absent"},
    {"ordinal":1,"function":"definition","proposition":"Prefect is a Python workflow orchestration framework for building data pipelines.","support":"Lines 79–101 illustrate a Python workflow using Prefect flow and task decorators."},
    {"ordinal":2,"function":"promotion","proposition":"Prefect is the simplest way to turn a script into a production workflow.","support":"The getting-started example illustrates script conversion and deployment; no comparison supports 'simplest'."},
    {"ordinal":3,"function":"capability","proposition":"Prefect enables resilient, dynamic data pipelines that react to their surroundings and recover from unexpected changes.","support":"Line 58 names retries and event-based automations; line 122 describes event-triggered deployments; the tips link error handling and retries."},
    {"ordinal":4,"function":"promotion","proposition":"With only a few lines of code, data teams can confidently automate any data process using scheduling, caching, retries, and event-based automations.","support":"The examples illustrate a short workflow and scheduling; tips mention retries, and line 122 links event automation. No example demonstrates caching or substantiates 'any data process'."},
    {"ordinal":5,"function":"capability","proposition":"Workflow activity is tracked and can be monitored through a self-hosted Prefect server or a managed Prefect Cloud dashboard.","support":"Links to Prefect server documentation and the Cloud comparison page; lines 104–107 instruct starting the server and viewing its UI."},
    {"ordinal":6,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"absent"},
    {"ordinal":7,"function":"qualification","proposition":"Prefect requires Python 3.11+.","support":"absent"},
    {"ordinal":8,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Install the latest version of Prefect by running one of the supplied commands.","support":"Installation link https://www.prefect.io/docs/v3/get-started/install and the commands `pip install -U prefect` and `uv add prefect`."},
    {"ordinal":9,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Create and run a Python file that uses Prefect.","support":"The surrounding sentence specifies `flow` and `task` decorators; lines 81–102 provide the Python example."},
    {"ordinal":10,"function":"other","proposition":"","support":"absent"},
    {"ordinal":11,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Use decorators to orchestrate and observe the workflow, illustrated by a script fetching a repository's GitHub star count.","support":"The surrounding sentence identifies `flow` and `task`; the example uses `@task(log_prints=True)`, `@flow(name=\"GitHub Stars\")`, and the GitHub API's `stargazers_count`."},
    {"ordinal":12,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Start a Prefect server and open its UI.","support":"The same sentence supplies http://localhost:4200; the following command is `prefect server start`."},
    {"ordinal":13,"function":"capability","proposition":"The UI lets you see what happened in the workflow.","support":"Line 60 describes tracking and monitoring workflow activity; the surrounding instruction opens the server UI after the example workflow."},
    {"ordinal":14,"function":"instruction","proposition":"To run the workflow every minute, turn it into a deployment by replacing the script's last line with the supplied code.","support":"Lines 113–118 show `github_stars.serve` with `name=\"first-deployment\"`, `cron=\"* * * * *\"`, and repository parameters."},
    {"ordinal":15,"function":"capability","proposition":"After the preceding setup, a local process looks for scheduled deployments.","support":"Conditional on running the preceding `github_stars.serve` example; no runtime output is provided."},
    {"ordinal":16,"function":"capability","proposition":"Workflows can also be run manually from the UI or CLI.","support":"absent"},
    {"ordinal":17,"function":"capability","proposition":"Deployments can run in response to events.","support":"The sentence links to https://www.prefect.io/docs/latest/automate/?utm_source=oss&utm_medium=oss&utm_campaign=oss_gh_repo&utm_term=none&utm_content=none."},
    {"ordinal":18,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"absent"},
    {"ordinal":19,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Use the agent setup guides to connect an agent to Prefect through plugins or MCP and start using the CLI.","support":"Agent setup guides linked at https://www.prefect.io/agents."},
    {"ordinal":20,"function":"capability","proposition":"An agent-readable setup index provides the guides in plain text.","support":"The index is linked at https://www.prefect.io/agents/llms.txt; its contents are not reproduced."},
    {"ordinal":21,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"absent"},
    {"ordinal":22,"function":"definition","proposition":"Prefect Cloud provides workflow orchestration for modern data enterprises.","support":"Line 60 describes its managed monitoring dashboard; line 140 links the Cloud comparison page."},
    {"ordinal":23,"function":"promotion","proposition":"Prefect automates over 200 million data tasks monthly and helps organizations, including Fortune 50 leader Progressive Insurance and Cash App, increase engineering productivity, reduce pipeline errors, and cut workflow compute costs.","support":"The sentence supplies the task count and named organizations, but the page provides no measurement source, case studies, or outcome data."},
    {"ordinal":24,"function":"promotion","proposition":"Read more about Prefect Cloud or sign up to try it.","support":"Links to https://www.prefect.io/cloud-vs-oss?utm_source=oss&utm_medium=oss&utm_campaign=oss_gh_repo&utm_term=none&utm_content=none and https://app.prefect.cloud?utm_source=oss&utm_medium=oss&utm_campaign=oss_gh_repo&utm_term=none&utm_content=none."},
    {"ordinal":25,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"absent"},
    {"ordinal":26,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Consider prefect-client if the use case focuses on communicating with Prefect Cloud or a remote Prefect server.","support":"Links to https://pypi.org/project/prefect-client/; the next sentence describes client-side SDK functionality."},
    {"ordinal":27,"function":"promotion","proposition":"prefect-client is a lighter-weight option for accessing Prefect SDK client-side functionality and is ideal for ephemeral execution environments.","support":"The preceding sentence scopes use to Prefect Cloud or a remote server and links the package; no size comparison or execution evidence is supplied."},
    {"ordinal":28,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"absent"},
    {"ordinal":29,"function":"promotion","proposition":"Readers are invited to join a thriving community of over 25,000 practitioners solving data challenges with Prefect.","support":"Community resources include a Slack link and describe thousands of practitioners; no source or count substantiates over 25,000."},
    {"ordinal":30,"function":"promotion","proposition":"Prefect's community is founded on collaboration, technical innovation, and continuous improvement.","support":"Community resources link contribution and integration guides; the closing paragraph names bug reports, feature suggestions, and documentation improvements."},
    {"ordinal":31,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"absent"},
    {"ordinal":32,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Explore comprehensive documentation and API references, connect with thousands on Slack, contribute to the project, support or create integrations to extend Prefect, and follow its open source development blog.","support":"Links to https://www.prefect.io/docs, https://prefect.io/slack, https://www.prefect.io/docs/contribute/, https://www.prefect.io/docs/contribute/contribute-integrations, and https://dev-log.prefect.io/. Linked contents and Slack membership counts are not shown."},
    {"ordinal":33,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"absent"},
    {"ordinal":34,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Subscribe to the newsletter for Prefect news; use X and Bluesky for updates, YouTube for tutorials and webinars, and LinkedIn for professional networking and company news.","support":"Links to https://prefect.io/newsletter, https://x.com/PrefectIO, https://bsky.app/profile/prefect.io, https://www.youtube.com/@PrefectIO, and https://www.linkedin.com/company/prefect; channel contents are not reproduced."},
    {"ordinal":35,"function":"promotion","proposition":"Reader contributions, questions, and ideas improve Prefect every day.","support":"Contribution guides are linked, but no examples or daily improvement evidence are supplied."},
    {"ordinal":36,"function":"promotion","proposition":"Bug reports, feature suggestions, and documentation improvements are invaluable to the Prefect community.","support":"The community resources link contribution guidance; no specific contribution outcomes substantiate the valuation."}
  ]
}
